purpose: Teach: エコロジー/ダーウィン/コンドーム/左脳/王宮/地球人/父兄/中尉

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、エコロジー視点の商品開発を進めろ
lines.en: Develop products with an ecological perspective. That's the direction.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Slight pause between the directive and the confirmation. Calm but expectant—this is not negotiable, merely stated.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ダーウィン的競争原理を取り入れます
lines.en: Understood. We'll incorporate Darwinian competitive principles into the approach.
lines.style: Respectful, methodical response. Even cadence, affirming each concept. Professional distance maintained—showing competence without overstepping.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、コンドームメーカーとの共同企画も視野に入れろ
lines.en: And we're exploring a joint venture with a condom manufacturer. Factor that in.
lines.style: Direct, matter-of-fact. No hesitation on the unusual detail—stated as routine business. Eyes steady, tone unbothered by the absurdity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の左脳トレーニングを支援します
lines.en: Yes. We'll support staff training in lateral thinking as well.
lines.style: Flat acknowledgment, then a gentle pivot. The second sentence is diplomatic—accepting without questioning, reframing slightly toward feasibility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、王宮御用達ブランドを目指せ
lines.en: Aim for royal warrant status. Position the brand accordingly.
lines.style: Clipped, confident. The words land like stepping stones. Each directive carries its own weight. No elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地球人向けという広告は避けます
lines.en: Understood. We'll avoid any messaging that positions this as broadly earthling-targeted.
lines.style: Quiet agreement, then a careful restatement that shows he's parsed the implication. Slight self-awareness in the phrasing—he knows it sounds odd but is moving forward anyway.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、父兄会との連携を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen coordination with the parent-teacher association. Make it happen.
lines.style: Brisk, final-sounding. The second sentence clips off—no room for pushback. Authority settling into place.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。元中尉経験者の社員も尊重します
lines.en: Acknowledged. We'll also ensure our former military staff members are properly recognized.
lines.style: Simple, clear closure. The addition is earnest, slightly formal—a sign of respect without commentary. Voice levels off, meeting concluded.
